    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ArduinoBoard
    A type token for an Arduino board @Board can select as a compilation target.
    ArduinoCore
    The Arduino core a Board is built with.
    ArduinoUnoQ
    Selects the Arduino UNO Q as @Board's target: Juno programs run on its STM32U585 microcontroller (Cortex-M33) under Arduino's Zephyr core.
    ArduinoUnoR4WiFi
    Selects the Arduino UNO R4 WiFi as @Board's target; has the onboard 12x8 LED matrix.
    ArrayDeclaration
    One local array a method declares via IrInstruction.NewArray, hoisted to the top of the function.
    ArrayElementType
    The element type of a Juno-supported array.
    AtomicSupport
    The deliberately small java.util.concurrent.atomic subset lowered by Juno: AtomicInteger, AtomicBoolean and AtomicLong, each an arena cell the cooperative scheduler can never interrupt halfway through an operation.
    BasicBlock
    A maximal run of instructions with one entry point (start) and one exit (terminator).
    BaudRate
    Common baud rates exposed as named values by Juno's USB serial API.
    BigNumberMethods
    The java.math subset: BigInteger, BigDecimal and MathContext.
    BigNumberSupport
    Closed-world plumbing for the java.math subset: BigInteger, BigDecimal and MathContext are one-word handles to immutable arena blocks, and RoundingMode is its ordinal.
    BigNumberSupport.Constant
    A static final field Juno materializes itself: a constructed value or a plain ordinal.
    BinaryOp
    A binary arithmetic or bitwise operation, with Java int (32-bit two's complement) semantics.
    BlockMerging
    Joins a block that ends in a Jump with its target when it is that target's only way in, so straight-line code (an inlined body and its continuation, say) is one block with no branch between the halves.
    Board
    Declares which Arduino board(s) a Juno program targets, e.g.
    Board
    A Juno compilation target, resolved from the entry-point class's @Board annotation (see io.github.jabrena.juno.annotations.Board).
    BootstrapMethod
    One entry in a class file's BootstrapMethods attribute.
    BoundsCheckElimination
    Removes a IrInstruction.BoundsCheck whose index is proved to lie in [0, length).
    BytecodeDecoder
    Decodes the intentionally small JVM bytecode subset supported by Juno v0.1.
    BytecodeToIr
    Lowers each reachable method's JVM bytecode into Juno IR: a non-SSA, block-structured form where every operand-stack push/pop becomes an explicit Value produced or consumed by an IrInstruction.
    Capability
    An optional on-board feature a Juno program can depend on.
    ClassFileReader
     
    ClassPath
    Loads class files from directories, individual class files, and JARs.
    Clock
    Monotonic clock operations recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno.
    CompilationMetrics
    Deterministic structural measurements of one Juno compilation.
    CompilationReport
    What the compiler found while producing a CompilationResult.
    CompilationRequest
    What to compile: a closed-world classpath plus the entry point's fully qualified class name.
    CompilationResult
    Generated Cortex-M4 assembly, its C++ runtime shim, entry symbol, and compilation report.
    CompileException
    A user-facing error produced while linking or compiling Java bytecode.
    CompilerPass
    One IR-to-IR transformation in the optimization pipeline, run between lowering and the backend.
    Condition
    The comparison an IrInstruction.Compare evaluates between its two operands.
    ConfigAnalyzer
    Compares the RuntimeConfig with what the program needs and suggests a better one.
    ConfigSuggestion
    A change to the runtime configuration that would suit the program better.
    ConfigSuggestionFormatter
    Renders ConfigSuggestions as human-readable lines, shared by the CLI and the Maven plugin.
    ConstantFolder
    Folds Binary/Unary/Compare instructions into Const when their operands are known constants, and folds a Branch into a Jump when its condition is a known constant.

    ConstantTables
    Read-only lookup tables kept in flash (.rodata) instead of the 8 KiB arena: a static final one-dimensional primitive array whose <clinit> initializer is all compile-time constants (static final short[] T = {1, 2, 3};) and which every reachable method only ever reads as T[i] or T.length.
    ConstantTables.RamFallback
    A static final constant-initialized array that has to stay in the arena, and why.
    ConstantTables.Table
    One flash-resident table: element values as raw bits, sign-extended for the integer types.
    ControlFlowGraph
    The basic blocks of one method, in offset order, with branch targets resolved into block-to-block edges.
    ControlFlowGraph
    The control-flow graph of one IrMethod, shared by the data-flow passes: every block's successors and predecessors (by block start), a reverse postorder from the entry block, and the dominator tree.
    ControlFlowGraphBuilder
    Partitions a method's decoded instructions into BasicBlocks and resolves every branch target into a CFG edge, replacing byte-offset jumps with an explicit block graph.
    CopyPropagation
    Eliminates a IrInstruction.LoadLocal when preceding stores determine the slot's value.
    DeadBlockElimination
    Removes basic blocks unreachable from a method's entry block.
    DeadLocalStoreElimination
    Removes stores to JVM/synthetic local slots that no later load can read.
    DeadValueElimination
    Removes instructions that only compute a value nothing reads: constants, local loads, integer arithmetic other than division and remainder (which can panic on zero), comparisons and conversions.
    Delay
    Timing operations recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno.
    Descriptor
     
    DigitalOutput
    A zero-cost GPIO handle.
    ExceptionHandler
    One Code attribute exception-table entry: instructions in [startPc, endPc) that throw a catchType (or any throwable when catchType is null, as finally uses) continue at handlerPc.
    FieldInfo
     
    FieldRef
     
    FloatBinaryOp
    Arithmetic operations with Java float semantics.
    Gpio
    GPIO operations recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno.
    HttpClient
    A minimal HTTP/1.1 client recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno, backed by the Arduino WiFiS3 library's WiFiClient.
    HttpMethod
    Named HTTP methods for matching against HttpServer.method().
    HttpsClient
    A minimal HTTPS client recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno, backed by Arduino's WiFiSSLClient and its firmware CA bundle on UNO R4 WiFi, or Linux TLS through Arduino_RouterBridge on UNO Q.
    HttpServer
    A minimal, non-blocking HTTP/1.1 server recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno, backed by the Arduino WiFiS3 library's WiFiServer on UNO R4 WiFi and by BridgeTCPServer (a listener in arduino-router on Linux) on UNO Q.
    HttpStatus
    Named HTTP status codes for HttpServer.respond(int, String, String)'s status parameter, which stays a plain int — these are ordinary compile-time-constant int fields, not a new intrinsic or type, exactly like Gpio.OUTPUT.
    I2c
    Register access to an I2C peripheral on the board's primary I2C bus (Wire, the SDA/SCL pins), recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno and backed by the core-bundled Wire library.
    Infrared
    Serial bytes over modulated infrared light, recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno and bit-banged on two plain pins, with no Arduino library.
    Inliner
    Replaces a IrInstruction.Call to a small leaf method with the method's own blocks, so getters, setters, constructors and small math helpers cost no call, no prologue and no argument shuffling.
    Instruction
     
    InterfaceCallSite
    A bytecode invokeinterface site, uniquely identified within its caller.
    InterfaceDispatch
    Closed-world concrete targets of one reachable invokeinterface instruction.
    InterfaceDispatch.Target

    InterfaceTarget
    One object type-id branch and its concrete method in a closed-world interface dispatch.
    Intrinsic
    Every hardware operation Juno understands, independent of its Java method signature or Arduino lowering.
    IntrinsicRegistry
    The single place that resolves a Java MethodRef to the Intrinsic it implements.
    InvokeDynamicRef
    A resolved CONSTANT_InvokeDynamic call-site name/type plus its bootstrap-table index.
    IrBasicBlock
    A block of lowered IR instructions ending in a single IrTerminator.

    A 64-bit long value, materialized as two 32-bit halves (targetLow/targetHigh) since every JVM local/stack slot and every backend int32_t is 32-bit.

    IrInstruction.NewMultiArray

    IrProgram
    throwableClasses lists every exception class the program allocates; a class's index is the id stored in each of its objects' headers (see ThrowableTypes).
    IrRewriting
    Rebuilds IR nodes with their values, local slots and block targets mapped: every value an instruction defines or reads goes through values, every local slot through locals, and every jump target through blocks.

    superClassName is the internal name of the direct superclass, or null only for java/lang/Object itself (constant-pool index 0, per the class file spec).
    JavaMethod
     
    Json
    A bounded, non-allocating JSON field reader recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno.
    JunoCompiler
     
    JunoType
    The scalar runtime types a Juno IR Value can carry.
    LambdaCallSite
    Identity of one invokedynamic lambda factory in a reachable method.
    LambdaSite
    Fully resolved LambdaMetafactory.metafactory call site.
    LcdKeypadShield
    Driver for the common "LCD Keypad Shield" (a 16x2 HD44780-compatible character LCD in 4-bit mode, plus 5 buttons wired through a single resistor ladder into one analog pin), wired for its standard pinout as used by e.g.
    LedCanvas
    A pixel buffer for the board's built-in LED matrix (12x8 on the UNO R4 WiFi, 13x8 on the UNO Q), plus the shape and text drawing operations that paint into it.
    LedMatrix
    The board's built-in LED matrix operations, recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno: 12x8 on the UNO R4 WiFi and 13x8 on the UNO Q.
    LedMatrixFont
    A classic 5x7 dot-matrix font for digits and uppercase letters, sized to fit the UNO R4 WiFi's 12x8 LED matrix (two glyphs fit side by side: 5 + 1 gap + 5 = 11 of the 12 columns).
    LedMatrixFontAscii
    A 5x7 dot-matrix font covering the full printable ASCII range (32 space .. 126 ~), for printing arbitrary ASCII characters on the UNO R4 WiFi's 12x8 LED matrix one at a time (two glyphs fit side by side: 5 + 1 gap + 5 = 11 of the 12 columns).
    LedMatrixFontSmall
    A compact 3x5 dot-matrix font for digits 0-9, offered as a smaller alternative to the 5x7 LedMatrixFont (which it does not replace).
    LinkedMethod
     
    Linker
    Performs closed-world reachability and resolves every static call before code generation.
    LockSupport
    The concrete, deliberately small ReentrantLock subset lowered by Juno.
    Main
     
    Memory
    Read-only introspection into Juno's arena allocator, recognized as a compiler intrinsic.
    MethodHandleRef
    A resolved CONSTANT_MethodHandle whose target is a method or constructor.
    MethodRef
     
    Mouse
    USB HID mouse control recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno, backed by the Arduino Mouse library.
    NineAxisMotionShield
    The Bosch BNO055 orientation sensor of the Arduino 9 Axis Motion Shield, read over I2C as plain Java on top of I2c (so it needs no Arduino library).
    ParallelBus
    An 8-bit parallel output bus, as display shields wire it: eight data pins written together, latched by a write strobe pulsed low then high.
    Pop3Client
    A minimal POP3S client recognized as a compiler intrinsic by Juno, backed by the same board-specific implicit-TLS transport as HttpsClient.
    PoweredUpHubRemote
    A LEGO Powered Up hub (City Hub 88009, Technic Hub 88012, BOOST Move Hub 88006, DUPLO Train Hub, ...) controlled over Bluetooth Low Energy, recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno and backed by the Arduino ArduinoBLE library (arduino-cli lib install ArduinoBLE).
    PowerFunctionsRemote
    A LEGO Power Functions infrared remote (8885), which drives the motors, lights and servos plugged into an IR Receiver (8884) set to one of its four channels.
    Program
    classes is every class loaded from the classpath (not just reachable methods' owners) — needed so that lowering can resolve a getstatic on an enum constant field to its ordinal, since the field's owner class may differ from the reachable method's own owner and is otherwise never visited (its <clinit>/<init>/values()/etc. are deliberately never added to methods).
    Random
    Pseudorandom-number operations backed by Arduino's random generator.
    RandomAccessFileMethods
    The read-only java.io.RandomAccessFile subset, backed by the SD card's open-file table: a file opened with mode "r" by a compile-time literal path, then seek/getFilePointer/length, single-byte and buffer reads, skipBytes and close.
    RcxBrick
    Direct commands to an RCX brick that answer back, over the same infrared link as RcxRemote (set it up with RcxRemote.begin(int, int) first, with both the IR LED and the IR receiver module wired).
    RcxRemote
    The LEGO Mindstorms RCX infrared protocol, recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno: receives the button state of an RCX Remote Control (9709) and transmits the same remote-control and message commands to an RCX brick.
    RecordSupport
    A cheap, purely structural check (name + zero-arg descriptor against a record's component list) used by the linker's reachability scan to avoid rejecting a record accessor call as "not a Juno intrinsic" before it ever reaches lowering.
    RiskSeverity
    Severity of a runtime-risk diagnostic emitted after IR optimization.
    RuntimeConfig
    The capacities of the generated runtime: how much RAM the arena and the task stacks take.
    RuntimeLimits
    Runtime constants shared by analysis and the current UNO R4 backend.
    RuntimeRisk
    One stable, machine-readable runtime-risk finding.
    RuntimeRiskAnalyzer
    Conservative resource and runtime-risk analysis over the optimized closed-world IR.
    RuntimeRiskReport
    Resource estimates and runtime-risk findings for one closed-world compilation.
    RuntimeRiskReportFormatter
    Renders a RuntimeRiskReport as human-readable lines, shared by the CLI and the Maven plugin.
    ScalarReplacement
    Removes an allocation whose object never escapes the method, keeping its fields in local slots instead of the arena: no juno_alloc, no garbage for the collector, and field accesses that copy propagation and constant folding can see through.
    ScopedValueSupport
    Closed-world plumbing for the java.lang.ScopedValue subset (JDK 25, final API).
    ScoutRemote
    Remote control of a LEGO Scout brick (Robotics Discovery Set) over infrared, plain Java on top of Infrared: see there for the wiring of the IR receiver module and the IR LED.
    SdCard
    Access to an SPI SD card, backed by the Arduino SdFat library with long-file-name support enabled.
    Serial
    USB serial output recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno.
    Servo
    A zero-cost servo motor handle for a standard 3-wire hobby servo (signal, power, ground), backed by the Arduino Servo library.
    Smtp
    A minimal SMTP client recognized as a compiler intrinsic by Juno.
    StackFrameSizing
    Authoritative target-backend stack sizing shared with static runtime-risk analysis.
    StringConcatResolver
    Validates and decodes the bounded subset of javac's string-concatenation bootstrap protocol.
    StringConcatSite
    A validated StringConcatFactory.makeConcatWithConstants call site.
    StringConcatSite.ArgumentPart
     
    StringConcatSite.LiteralPart
     
    StringConcatSite.Part
    One literal fragment or dynamic argument in the bootstrap recipe.
    StructuredTaskSupport
    Closed-world plumbing for Juno's JDK 27 preview StructuredTaskScope subset.
    SupportedJdkMethods
    Small JDK bytecode idioms Juno lowers without linking their JDK implementations.
    Terminator
    Where control flow goes after the last instruction of a BasicBlock.
    Terminator.Branch
    A conditional branch: control goes to trueTarget or falls through to falseTarget.
    Terminator.Fallthrough
    Falls into the next block without an explicit branch instruction.
    Terminator.Jump
    Unconditional goto.
    Terminator.Return
    A supported JVM return opcode, or the implicit return past the last instruction of a method.
    Terminator.Switch
     
    Terminator.Throw
    athrow: control continues at one of handlers — the distinct handler offsets whose exception-table ranges cover the throw, in matching order — or leaves the method when none catches it.
    TftTouchShield
    Driver for the ELEGOO 2.8" TFT touch screen shield ("Pantalla Táctil TFT de 2,8 pulgadas"): a 240x320 ILI9341 display on an 8-bit parallel bus, a 4-wire resistive touch panel, and a microSD socket, wired for the shield's standard UNO pinout as used by ELEGOO's Elegoo_TFTLCD and TouchScreen libraries.
    ThreadSupport
    The closed-world plumbing behind java.lang.Thread: a started thread runs its Runnable on a stack of its own, entered from the runtime shim, so the linker registers one synthetic Runnable.run() call site that resolves against every reachable Runnable (classes and lambdas) and the lowering turns it into the generated thread entry function.
    ThrowableTypes
    The closed-world exception hierarchy: a fixed set of built-in JDK throwables (which Juno models itself, since their class files are never on the classpath) plus any program class whose superclass chain reaches one of them.
    Thumb2AsmBackend
    Emits GNU ARM Thumb-2 assembly straight from Juno IR, restricted to instructions common to the UNO R4's Cortex-M4 and the UNO Q's Cortex-M33, so one code generator serves every board; per-core runtime differences live in CoreRuntime.
    Thumb2AsmBackend.Output
    runtimeShim is a small extern "C" C++ source that must be compiled alongside assembly in the same sketch — see this class's doc.
    Udp
    Allocation-free UDP transport recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno.
    UnaryOp
    A single-operand operation: arithmetic negation or a narrowing conversion.
    Value
    A typed symbolic virtual register: one value, produced by exactly one IrInstruction.
    Watchdog
    Enables the RA4M1's hardware watchdog timer on @Watchdog's entry-point class.
    Wifi
    WiFi connection control recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno, backed by the Arduino board networking stack (WiFiS3 on UNO R4 WiFi, Arduino_RouterBridge on UNO Q).
    WifiProvisioner
    Wi-Fi provisioning without baking credentials into the firmware, written in plain Java on top of Wifi and HttpServer (it adds no intrinsics, and costs nothing in a program that does not call it).
